● Add relatives, WHERE NEEDED:

1. 1 The book — I was reading yesterday was a detective story.
2. 2 The man — you spoke to in the street is my English teacher.
3. 3 I should like to see the trees — you picked these apples from.
4. 4 There's the lady — purse has been stolen.
5. 5 The people — you were living with in London are coming to see you.
6. 6 The picture — you were talking about has been sold.
7. 7 People — live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.
8. 8 Buy it back from the man — you sold it to.
9. 9 What's the name of that man — wife has run away and left him?
10. 10 Can you remember the person — you took it from?
11. 11 Where is there a shop — sells picture-postcards?
12. 12 That's the knife and fork — I eat with.
13. 13 Where is the man — sold me these sun-glasses?
14. 14 What's that music — you are listening to?
15. 15 I don't like the house — he lives in.
16. 16 The man — made these shoes doesn't know his trade.
17. 17 Here comes the girl — I am hiding from.
18. 18 The people — are looking at that house are my parents.
19. 19 The house — they are looking at is my house.
20. 20 And the girl — you see at the door is my sister.
